<plan>
drive car2 nilkantha-hospital tadi-village
drive car2 tadi-village trishuli-care-home
load car2 elderly 3
drive car2 trishuli-care-home tadi-village
drive car2 tadi-village nilkantha-hospital
unload car2 elderly 3
drive car2 nilkantha-hospital tadi-village
drive car2 tadi-village trishuli-care-home
drive car2 trishuli-care-home uttargaya-market
load car2 adult 4
drive car2 uttargaya-market trishuli-care-home
drive car2 trishuli-care-home tadi-village
drive car2 tadi-village nilkantha-hospital
unload car2 adult 4
defer suryagadhi-market elderly 4
defer suryagadhi-market adult 6
defer suryagadhi-market child 2
defer panchakanya-farm adult 1
defer belkot-village adult 1
</plan>
COST: 566

Notes on the plan:
- **Driving: 86 min.** Car2 makes two round trips from Nilkantha hospital: one to rescue the three elderly at Trishuli care home (30 min), and one to rescue the four adults at Uttargaya market (56 min).
- **Car1 is not used.** The Thakre shelter to Trishuli care home road has fast floodwater and a truck was swept off it, so I treated it as unusable. Even if it were usable, sending car1 would not lower the total cost.
- **Deferred: 480 min of penalties.** Suryagadhi market (4 elderly, 6 adults, 2 children) costs 228 min per round trip to reach, and one car can carry at most 4 people, so the best possible savings per trip (220 min, from 2 children and 2 elderly) is less than the trip cost. Panchakanya farm is cut off by a washed-out bridge. Belkot village's adult would need a 42-minute detour for a 20-minute penalty.
- **Operational caveat:** this is a purely cost-based result. The 12 people at Suryagadhi market, including two children, are deferred only because of the cost model. The coordinators should review whether a later wave, or a different allocation, is acceptable on humanitarian grounds before relying on this plan.
